name: Export surplus to fund generator fuel
description: An OpenRepublic synthetic grain trade post exports accumulated surplus, then imports priced coal for a generator whose power output is measured by the scenario score.
catalog:
openrepublic-economy 1
resource grain
trade grain buy 2 sell 5
resource coal
trade coal buy 3 sell 1
resource goods
utility power
building grain_trade_post 1 1
  store grain 64
  recipe harvest every 1 out grain:2
  tradepost
end
building coal_generator 1 1
  store coal 64
  recipe generate every 1 in coal:1 out power:2
  tradepost
end
building power_consumer 1 1
  store goods 64
  recipe consume every 1 in power:1 out goods:1
end
